description: Trace a wallet's money through counterparties. direction=out follows where funds went, in where they came from, both (default) either way. At each hop, expand to the top N counterparties by USD volume in that direction. Returns nodes + edges of the resulting graph. Use when the user asks 'where did funds from X go' (out) / 'who funded Y' (in) / 'follow the money 3 hops from Z' / wallet investigation.

direction.description: out = where funds went, in = where they came from, both = either (default both)

min_usd.description: Minimum USD per transfer to follow (default 10000)

width.description: Top N counterparties per hop (1-10, default 5)

name: wallet_trace
title: Wallet Trace
